metadata.case_name: YU SHUI CHUN v. CLUB CHISEN LIMITED

injuries.description: Fracture to the head of the right femur
source: She sustained a fracture to the head of her right femur from which she continues to suffer pain, discomfort and some disability.
The fracture was classified as a "Garden Type II" - namely a complete fracture, but without displacement.

injuries.description: Avascular Necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head
source: the fracture of the femoral head has led to the condition known as Avascular Necrosis, or AVN as it is called in the trade.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

source: Based on x-rays in November 1997 and May 1998, he considers her present stage of AVN to be at least stage III on the Ficat scale, with indications that stage IV (osteoarthritis) has commenced by reason of narrowing of the joint space.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: The plaintiff apparently suffered severe pain in her right hip as an immediate result of the accident.
she continues to suffer pain, discomfort and some disability
she walks with a limp and uses a stick
she cannot run, she walks with a limp, she cannot play golf or tennis, go jogging or perform aerobics, all of which she used to do regularly before the accident.
she cannot dance and does not therefore go to parties
suffering from insomnia and depression, low self-esteem, feeling socially isolated and suffering irrational fears about weight on her injured hip.
loss of stamina and stomach pain from ulcers as a result of the anti-inflammatory drugs

treatments_received: emergency fixation with three screws under general anaesthesia
admitted to Queen Mary Hospital (28 - 30 December 1991)
transfer to Maclehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre and release on 25 March 1992
admission to Maclehose Rehabilitation Centre from 3 June to 10 July 1998
multiple visits to doctors and health care specialists
treatments_future: aids to daily living and rehabilitation equipment (e.g. treadmill)

losses.description: Fracture of the head of her right femur leading to AVN and subsequent disability.
Walks with a limp and requires a stick; reduced ability to move and reasonable mobility compromised.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cannot run, cannot play golf or tennis, go jogging or perform aerobics, cannot dance.
Does not go to parties; social isolation; relationship with boyfriend of 10 years ended in 1995.
Insomnia, depression, low self-esteem and irrational fears about weight on her injured hip leading to social withdrawal.
Requires general domestic help to be independent of her mother who now does all the housework.
